candidate_relations.reason: Mycosis fungoides is a specific subtype of Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma. The immunophenotype described (CD4-negative) is a characteristic of the tumor cells in this case, but 'Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma, CD4-negative' is a broader category than the more specific 'Mycosis fungoides' which is the reference diagnosis. The reference diagnosis is a more precise classification within the CTCL spectrum.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Mycosis fungoides is a type of Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma. The CD4-negative aspect is a specific immunophenotype, but Mycosis fungoides itself is not inherently CD4-negative.
